description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR3. Descr::union calls normalize_empty_nonempty_list_unions (descr.rs ~523, dnf.rs ~39-74), which MERGES [] ∨ nonempty[T] into [T], while intern's list pass only absorbs; the same denotation reached through difference, intersect or substitution is not merged. Merge at intern (canon's denotational list_clause, canon.rs ~225-262: [] ∨ nonempty[T] → [T], list(T) & not([]) → non_empty_list(T)), then delete the union-path normalizer. Tests: every_route_to_a_possibly_empty_list_interns_once, the_union_path_owns_no_list_normalizer.

comments.text: Measured cause of fold-order non-confluence (2026-09-15, on fz-kdt.48/one-ty-per-denotation at f0c28c2a8): dnf::normalize_empty_nonempty_list_unions is an order-dependent rewrite inside Descr::union, before intern. When an exact [] clause is present it widens every exact non-empty clause present at that moment to admit [] and drops the [] clause, so the result depends on when [] arrives. Members nel(binary), nel(nil), nel(nil), empty_list(): folded forward -> list(nil) | list(binary); folded reverse -> nel(binary) | list(nil). Both are in canonical clause order, both equivalent, two ids. Clause order (.48.3) and absorption (.48.4) cannot see it; the census counts the pair but not the cause. Fix belongs here: one list normal form applied at intern, the union-path rewrite deleted. Reproducer kept at the coordinator's scratchpad (48-6-fold-order-reproducer.rs) for the test.

title: One list normal form, one authority
